kalsarp: Kalsarp Dosha (all planets hemmed between Rahu and Ketu) — common remedies: chanting Maha Mrityunjaya mantra, worship of Lord Shiva on Mondays, Naga Panchami rituals, and Rahu/Ketu shanti puja, ideally at a Kalsarp-dosha-nivaran site (e.g. Trimbakeshwar).
pitru: Pitru Dosha (affliction from ancestral debts, often via Sun/Rahu/Ketu and the 9th house) — common remedies: Pitru Paksha shraddha rites, Tarpan/Pind Daan for ancestors, feeding Brahmins/the needy, and recitation of the Garuda Purana.
stri: Stri Dosha (affliction to marital happiness, often via Venus) — common remedies: worship of Goddess Parvati/Lakshmi, Venus (Shukra) shanti puja, and charity toward women on Fridays.
